finding: Current MLflow documentation supports local tracking and SQLite-backed metadata; a tracking server is optional for this project.
project_impact: Select MLflow as optional local-first tracking adapter, not production truth or mandatory server.

finding: Official tutorial documents local SQLite tracking URI/workflow.
project_impact: Use local SQLite as preferred initial MLflow metadata store when materialized.

finding: Optuna supports persistent RDB-backed studies including local SQLite for resumable local studies.
project_impact: Select Optuna adapter for development-only HPO; persist study state.

finding: Optuna Journal storage provides file-based persistent/parallel study support.
project_impact: Prefer Journal storage over shared SQLite for file/multiprocess parallel workflows.

finding: Official FAQ warns SQLite is not suitable for distributed/NFS optimization and points to Journal storage.
project_impact: Prohibit SQLite as a distributed/NFS HPO backend.

finding: Tracking supports run metadata, metrics, artifacts, local/database backends, and optional tracking server deployment.
project_impact: Keep MLflow as local-first replaceable tracking adapter; canonical experiment identity remains independent.

finding: Official local-database tutorial uses SQLite-backed tracking metadata.
project_impact: Use local SQLite metadata as initial adapter configuration when materialized.

finding: Journal storage supports persistent file-backed optimization and parallel workflows.
project_impact: Prefer Journal storage for file/multiprocess local-first HPO workflows.

finding: Git worktree provides multiple working trees attached to one repository with separate working state.
project_impact: Retain worktree isolation when Git metadata is available; packaged ZIPs use immutable source snapshot fallback.
